message.content:
This is a Skee-Ball-type game for home use, not coin-operated. It falls under HTSUS heading 9504, which covers articles for arcade, table or parlor games.

Subheading 9504.30 covers other games, coin- or token-operated, other than bowling alley equipment. The Speedball unit has no coin mechanism, so that subheading does not apply.

Subheading 9504.90 covers other articles. Its 10-digit statistical lines include 9504.90.2000, for table games, and 9504.90.4000, for other games, but I am less sure which one applies. Rulings on similar products point to 9504.90.9080 (other). I recall a CBP ruling on a Skee-Ball-like game that classified it in 9504.90.9080, "Other: Other." Since I cannot confirm the exact ruling, I am going with that code.

{"hts_code": "9504.90.9080", "reason": "A non-coin-operated, free-standing Skee-Ball-style arcade game is an article for arcade games of heading 9504, falling in the residual subheading 9504.90 for other games."}
